statements.t: Headwinds in the industry, such as continued pressures on linear distribution and declines in linear subscribers and continued softness in the U.S. linear advertising market, have had, and are expected to continue to have, a material impact on the operations and results of the Company, including a negative impact on the results of operations attributed to declines in linear advertising revenue.

The segment distributing the content, e.g., via our streaming or linear services, capitalizes the cost of inter-segment content transactions, including “mark-ups” and amortizes the costs over the shorter of the license term, if applicable, or the expected period of use.
We plan to continue to invest significantly in the creation and acquisition of new content, as well as certain sports rights.

Any such repurchases or exchanges will be dependent upon several factors, including our liquidity requirements, contractual restrictions, general market conditions, as well as applicable regulatory, legal and accounting factors.
Whether or not we repurchase or exchange any debt and the size and timing of any such repurchases or exchanges will be determined at our discretion.
We expect to continue to incur significant costs to develop and market HBO Max.
We expect to continue to make payments for income taxes and interest on our outstanding First Lien Credit Facility and senior notes.
Credit rating agencies may continue to review and adjust our ratings or outlook.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company intends to remit certain previously undistributed foreign earnings to the United States.
statements.was: As of March 31, 2026, the Company intends to remit certain previously undistributed foreign earnings to the United States.

statements.t: Accordingly, the Company has recorded deferred taxes for applicable foreign withholding associated with the expected remittance.

dropped.t: We expect to refinance or repay the Bridge Loan Facility prior to its maturity, though we may be unable to do so on favorable terms in a timely manner or at all.
